title: Vallée knows more than he can communicate

tellings.quote: when I speak to Jacques, I get the sense that, uh, he knows a lot more than he can even communicate with this stuff

plain: Jacques Vallée, a computer scientist and long-time UFO researcher, knows much more about the subject than he is able to put into words, according to Michels. Michels says this in 2025 as his own impression from speaking with Vallée, saying he gets "the sense" that Vallée "knows a lot more than he can even communicate." It is a personal feeling, not something Vallée is quoted as saying.
